card.name: Start of a term after a heading word
card.fires_on: The first piece of a drug, disease or term that follows a verb or adjective in a label heading or table row. Examples are Discontinue TEMODAR, Decreased Overall, Moderate to Severe Renal.

modes.label: Drug name after a verb
modes.description: The first piece of a brand or generic drug name right after Discontinue, Reconstitute or Withhold.
modes.example: Discontinue<< TEM>>ODAR if unable to tolerate a dose

modes.label: Term after a heading adjective
modes.description: The start of a medical term following an adjective in a section heading or table.
modes.example: Moderate to Severe<< Ren>>al Impairment or End Stage Ren

card.writes: It seems to push the model toward finishing the split word with its next piece, such as 'pac' or 'cci'.
card.plain: It fires on the first piece of a drug or medical term that follows a heading or instruction word in a label.
